## Select the optimal number of topics
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Split-half topic reproducibility with matched/off-diagonal summaries
# ============================================================

# Optional: build gene_mat if not already in memory
# rna_df <- read.csv("rna_for_seurat.csv", check.names = FALSE)
# gene_mat <- data.matrix(rna_df[, -(1:6)])

stopifnot(is.matrix(gene_mat))
stopifnot(is.numeric(gene_mat))
stopifnot(!anyNA(gene_mat))
stopifnot(all(is.finite(gene_mat)))
stopifnot(min(gene_mat, na.rm = TRUE) >= 0)

one_split_metrics <- function(gene_mat, k, subset_size = 10000, numiter = 50,
                              seed_split = 1, seed_fit = 1,
                              similarity_mode = c("cosine", "cosine_log_topic_eps"),
                              eps_sim = 1e-12) {
  similarity_mode <- match.arg(similarity_mode)

  stopifnot(2 * subset_size <= nrow(gene_mat))

  set.seed(seed_split)
  all_idx <- sample.int(nrow(gene_mat), 2 * subset_size)
  idx1 <- all_idx[1:subset_size]
  idx2 <- all_idx[(subset_size + 1):(2 * subset_size)]

  mat1 <- gene_mat[idx1, , drop = FALSE]
  mat2 <- gene_mat[idx2, , drop = FALSE]

  mat1 <- mat1[rowSums(mat1) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  mat2 <- mat2[rowSums(mat2) > 0, , drop = FALSE]

  mat1_sp <- Matrix(mat1, sparse = TRUE)
  mat2_sp <- Matrix(mat2, sparse = TRUE)

  set.seed(seed_fit)
  fit1 <- fit_poisson_nmf(mat1_sp, k = k, numiter = numiter, verbose = "none",
                          control = list(extrapolate = TRUE))
  fit2 <- fit_poisson_nmf(mat2_sp, k = k, numiter = numiter, verbose = "none",
                          control = list(extrapolate = TRUE))

  fit1 <- poisson2multinom(fit1)
  fit2 <- poisson2multinom(fit2)

  beta1 <- fit1$F
  beta2 <- fit2$F

  if (similarity_mode == "cosine") {
    X1 <- beta1
    X2 <- beta2
  } else {
    c0 <- 1e-4
    eps_min <- 1e-12
    eps_max <- 1e-2

    med1 <- apply(beta1, 2, median, na.rm = TRUE)
    med2 <- apply(beta2, 2, median, na.rm = TRUE)

    eps1_k <- pmin(pmax(c0 * med1, eps_min), eps_max)
    eps2_k <- pmin(pmax(c0 * med2, eps_min), eps_max)

    X1 <- log(sweep(beta1, 2, eps1_k, FUN = "+"))
    X2 <- log(sweep(beta2, 2, eps2_k, FUN = "+"))
  }

  sim_mat <- as.matrix(proxy::simil(t(X1), t(X2), method = "cosine"))
  assignment <- clue::solve_LSAP(sim_mat, maximum = TRUE)
  sim_reord <- sim_mat[, assignment, drop = FALSE]

  diag_vals <- diag(sim_reord)
  off_vals  <- sim_reord[row(sim_reord) != col(sim_reord)]

  nearest_wrong <- sapply(seq_len(k), function(i) max(sim_reord[i, -i, drop = TRUE]))

  data.frame(
    similarity_mode = similarity_mode,
    S_match = mean(diag_vals),
    S_off = mean(off_vals),
    gap = mean(diag_vals) - mean(off_vals),
    ratio = mean(diag_vals) / mean(off_vals),
    mean_margin = mean(diag_vals - nearest_wrong)
  )
}

score_for_K <- function(gene_mat, K, B = 20, subset_size = 10000, numiter = 50,
                        base_seed_split = 1000, base_seed_fit = 5000,
                        similarity_mode = c("cosine", "cosine_log_topic_eps"),
                        eps_sim = 1e-12, verbose = TRUE) {
  similarity_mode <- match.arg(similarity_mode)

  metrics_list <- vector("list", B)

  for (b in seq_len(B)) {
    mb <- one_split_metrics(
      gene_mat,
      k = K,
      subset_size = subset_size,
      numiter = numiter,
      seed_split = base_seed_split + 1000 * K + b,
      seed_fit   = base_seed_fit   + 1000 * K + b,
      similarity_mode = similarity_mode,
      eps_sim = eps_sim
    )

    mb$K <- K
    mb$split <- b
    metrics_list[[b]] <- mb

    if (verbose) {
      cat("mode =", similarity_mode,
          " K =", K,
          " b =", b,
          " S_match =", round(mb$S_match, 4),
          " S_off =", round(mb$S_off, 4),
          " gap =", round(mb$gap, 4),
          " ratio =", round(mb$ratio, 4),
          " margin =", round(mb$mean_margin, 4), "\n")
    }
  }

  metrics_df <- bind_rows(metrics_list)

  summarise_metric <- function(x) {
    m  <- mean(x)
    sd <- stats::sd(x)
    se <- sd / sqrt(length(x))
    c(mean = m, sd = sd, ci95_lo = m - 1.96 * se, ci95_hi = m + 1.96 * se)
  }

  sm_match  <- summarise_metric(metrics_df$S_match)
  sm_off    <- summarise_metric(metrics_df$S_off)
  sm_gap    <- summarise_metric(metrics_df$gap)
  sm_ratio  <- summarise_metric(metrics_df$ratio)
  sm_margin <- summarise_metric(metrics_df$mean_margin)

  summary_df <- data.frame(
    K = K,
    B = B,
    similarity_mode = similarity_mode,

    S_match_mean = sm_match["mean"],
    S_match_ci95_lo = sm_match["ci95_lo"],
    S_match_ci95_hi = sm_match["ci95_hi"],

    S_off_mean = sm_off["mean"],
    S_off_ci95_lo = sm_off["ci95_lo"],
    S_off_ci95_hi = sm_off["ci95_hi"],

    gap_mean = sm_gap["mean"],
    gap_ci95_lo = sm_gap["ci95_lo"],
    gap_ci95_hi = sm_gap["ci95_hi"],

    ratio_mean = sm_ratio["mean"],
    ratio_ci95_lo = sm_ratio["ci95_lo"],
    ratio_ci95_hi = sm_ratio["ci95_hi"],

    mean_margin_mean = sm_margin["mean"],
    mean_margin_ci95_lo = sm_margin["ci95_lo"],
    mean_margin_ci95_hi = sm_margin["ci95_hi"]
  )

  list(summary = summary_df, splits = metrics_df)
}
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# Run across K and similarity modes
# ============================================================
Ks <- c(2, 6, 10, 14, 18, 22, 26, 30, 34, 38, 42)
B <- 20
subset_size <- 10000
numiter <- 45
modes <- c("cosine", "cosine_log_topic_eps")

all_summaries <- list()
all_splits <- list()

for (mode in modes) {
  for (K in Ks) {
    out <- score_for_K(
      gene_mat,
      K = K,
      B = B,
      subset_size = subset_size,
      numiter = numiter,
      similarity_mode = mode,
      eps_sim = 1e-12,
      verbose = TRUE
    )

    key <- paste(mode, K, sep = "_")
    all_summaries[[key]] <- out$summary
    all_splits[[key]] <- out$splits
  }
}

summary_df <- bind_rows(all_summaries)
splits_df  <- bind_rows(all_splits)
write.csv(summary_df, "summary_df_reproducibility.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(splits_df,  "splits_df_reproducibility.csv",  row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
B <- 20
summary_df <- read.csv("summary_df_reproducibility.csv")
splits_df  <- read.csv("splits_df_reproducibility.csv")
```



```{r}
# ============================================================
# Helper: keep the same jitter + line + CI + point style
# ============================================================
plot_metric_all_methods <- function(summary_df, splits_df, metric, B,
                                    ylab, title_text) {
  mean_col <- paste0(metric, "_mean")
  lo_col   <- paste0(metric, "_ci95_lo")
  hi_col   <- paste0(metric, "_ci95_hi")

  ggplot() +
    geom_jitter(
      data = splits_df,
      aes(x = factor(K), y = .data[[metric]], color = similarity_mode),
      width = 0.16, height = 0, alpha = 0.45, size = 1.1
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = summary_df,
      aes(x = factor(K), y = .data[[mean_col]],
          color = similarity_mode, group = similarity_mode),
      linewidth = 0.6,
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.35)
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      data = summary_df,
      aes(x = factor(K), ymin = .data[[lo_col]], ymax = .data[[hi_col]],
          color = similarity_mode),
      width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.6,
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.35)
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = summary_df,
      aes(x = factor(K), y = .data[[mean_col]], color = similarity_mode),
      size = 2.2,
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.35)
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      x = "Number of topics (K)",
      y = ylab,
      color = "Similarity metric",
      title = paste0(title_text, " (B = ", B, ")")
    )
}

plot_metric_one_method <- function(summary_df, splits_df, method_keep, metric, B,
                                   ylab, title_text) {
  mean_col <- paste0(metric, "_mean")
  lo_col   <- paste0(metric, "_ci95_lo")
  hi_col   <- paste0(metric, "_ci95_hi")

  summary_df_sub <- summary_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(similarity_mode == method_keep)

  splits_df_sub <- splits_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(similarity_mode == method_keep)

  ggplot() +
    geom_jitter(
      data = splits_df_sub,
      aes(x = factor(K), y = .data[[metric]]),
      width = 0.16, height = 0, alpha = 0.45, size = 1.1
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = summary_df_sub,
      aes(x = factor(K), y = .data[[mean_col]], group = 1),
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      data = summary_df_sub,
      aes(x = factor(K), ymin = .data[[lo_col]], ymax = .data[[hi_col]]),
      width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = summary_df_sub,
      aes(x = factor(K), y = .data[[mean_col]]),
      size = 2.2
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      x = "Number of topics (K)",
      y = ylab,
      title = paste0(title_text, " — ", method_keep, " (B = ", B, ")")
    )
}
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# Plot block 1: all methods together
# ============================================================
plot_metric_all_methods(
  summary_df, splits_df,
  metric = "S_match",
  B = B,
  ylab = "Matched similarity (S_match)",
  title_text = "Matched topic similarity with 95% CI"
)

plot_metric_all_methods(
  summary_df, splits_df,
  metric = "S_off",
  B = B,
  ylab = "Off-diagonal similarity (S_off)",
  title_text = "Off-diagonal (wrong-topic) similarity with 95% CI"
)

plot_metric_all_methods(
  summary_df, splits_df,
  metric = "ratio",
  B = B,
  ylab = "Ratio = S_match / S_off",
  title_text = "Matched-vs-off-diagonal separation ratio with 95% CI"
)

plot_metric_all_methods(
  summary_df, splits_df,
  metric = "gap",
  B = B,
  ylab = "Gap = S_match - S_off",
  title_text = "Matched-vs-off-diagonal separation gap with 95% CI"
)
```
